title: Hector and Hecuba
intro: Hecuba offers wine and rest. Hector refuses and directs her towards Athena's temple.

notes.text: περικαλλής, very beautiful: acc sg; τεύχω perf mid/pass ptc acc sg, built / adorned.
ξεστός, polished / dressed; αἴθουσα, porch / colonnade: dat pl.
ἔνειμι, be within: 3pl impf; θάλαμος, chamber / bedroom.
δέμω, build: perf mid/pass ptc nom pl, not δάμνημι, subdue.
κοιμάομαι, sleep: unaugmented 3pl impf; μνηστός, wooed / wedded; ἄλοχος, wife: dat pl.
κούρη, daughter: gen pl; ἑτέρωθεν, on the other side; ἔνδοθεν + gen, inside the courtyard.
τέγεος, roofed; twelve covered chambers opposite the sons' fifty rooms.
γαμβρός, son-in-law here; αἰδοῖος, honoured / respected, with wives.
ἠπιόδωρος, kindly giving / gentle; ἐναντίη, to meet him; ἤλυθε epic 3sg 2aor of ἔρχομαι.
ἐσάγω, bring in: pres ptc; εἶδος acc of respect, most beautiful in appearance.
φύω, grow / cling: unaugmented 3sg root aor, “clasped his hand”; οἱ possessive dat.
ἐξονομάζω separated by particles, call by name; unaugmented 3sg impf.
τίπτε, why; θρασύς, fierce / bold, with battle; ἔρχομαι epic 2sg perf, have come.
τείρω, wear down: 3pl pres; δυσώνυμος, ill-named / accursed, hostile epithet for the Greeks.
μάρναμαι, fight: pres ptc nom pl; ἀνίημι, impel / send up: 3sg aor, θυμός subject.
ἀνέχω, raise: 2aor act inf, stem σχε-; lifting hands in prayer. ἐξ ἄκρης πόλιος, from the citadel.
μελιηδής, honey-sweet: acc sg; φέρω 1sg aor subj, stem ἐνεικ-, after ὄφρα, “until / so that I bring.”
σπένδω, pour a libation: 2sg aor subj; purpose after ὡς.
καὶ αὐτός, you yourself too; ὀνίναμαι, benefit: epic 2sg fut mid, uncontracted.
πίνω, drink: epic 2sg 2aor subj with -σθα; “if you drink.”
κάμνω, toil / tire: perf act ptc dat sg, weary; ἀέξω = αὔξω, increase: 3sg pres.
τύνη, emphatic σύ, you; ἔτης, kinsman / comrade: dat pl. κέκμηκας, 2sg perf of κάμνω.
ἀείρω, bring / lift: 2sg pres imperative, negated; μελίφρων, honey-hearted / cheering; πότνια, honoured lady.
ἀπογυιόω, weaken / unnerve: 2sg aor subj after μή; gen of deprivation, of strength.
λανθάνομαι, forget: 1sg 2aor mid subj + gen; “lest I forget my fighting strength.”
ἄνιπτος, unwashed; λείβω, pour a libation: pres inf; αἶθοψ, gleaming / fiery: acc sg.
ἅζομαι, shrink in reverence: 1sg pres; κελαινεφής, dark-clouded: dat sg with Zeus.
λύθρον, gore / defilement; παλάσσω perf pass ptc acc sg, bespattered; εὐχετάομαι, pray: epic pres inf. Impersonal οὐκ ἔστι: not permissible.
ἀγελείη, Athena's traditional epithet, often “driver of spoil”; derivation uncertain. Instruction continues next page.
